slides.dek: Designed, written, queued. It never went live. Here's why.

slides.h: READY TO SHIP, SCORE ON THE COVER
body: A full trend receipt on a rising kitchen-appliance category. Our best chart of the week.
The cover quoted its signal score as of 'today'.

slides.h: THE FRESH PULL SAID A DIFFERENT NUMBER
body: Before anything ships, we re-pull the data. The category was still rising, but the score had slipped below the one printed on the slide.
Close enough that nobody would have noticed. Wrong enough that it wasn't true.

items: **Ship it anyway.** The design was done and the gap was small. Who checks?
**Swap the digits and pretend.** Change the number, keep the old story, hope they still match.
**Kill it and rebuild from fresh data.** Lose the slot, keep the promise on our grid honest.

slides.body: Receipts only, even when the receipt costs us the post.
